name: forge-spec
description: Author a specification the loop executes verbatim. Produces ticket-shaped markdown that `forge ingest` parses without a planner model rephrasing it, so the acceptance criteria a human wrote are the ones the executor is judged against.

memPalaceUrl.description: URL of the MemPalace MCP endpoint holding prior decisions and conventions. Leave as-is if you do not run one; the spec workflow works without it.
